name: com.aroundlex/events
title: Around Lex
description: Free, no sign-in: checked Lexington, Kentucky events, places and holiday guides, with source links.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Use when someone asks what's on in or near Lexington, KY: tonight, today, this weekend, a date or range, a holiday, a kind of event, a nearby town or free admission. Use when=tonight for tonight (from 4 pm, or now if later, until 3 am; with no query words left to match, what starts in it comes first, by start time), when=today or when=this-weekend, or from and to for other dates. The query may be a question in plain words: when they are not given, its time words (tonight, today, tomorrow, this or next weekend, a weekday) set the dates, a town's name after in, near, around, at or from, or before KY, sets town (Richmond Road stays a road, and a town's name on its own stays a word; when nothing in that town matches, an event whose title names the town and that holds every other word is the answer, with namedFor set to the town: it may be held elsewhere, as each event's venue says), and free or kids words set those filters; filler words are dropped, and droppedWords lists every word left out. town keeps one town's venues. Returns 10 upcoming events by default (limit, up to 20) with time, venue, price line, official source and check date, and for a date with no posted time the event's statusNote, plus how many matched in all, best match first for a query and by date otherwise; times are Lexington time. When no event holds every word of three or more, the answer lists the events that hold at least two and at least half of them, most first, and says matched=loose. When nothing matches, emptyReason says why and next is the next matching event. Does not sell tickets or confirm availability. Do not use for holiday hours, what is open on a holiday or church service times: get_guide has those.

query.description: Words to look for, like "live music", "farmers market", a venue name or a question in plain words ("basketball tonight", "things to do in Georgetown"). Leave out to list the next events by date.

from.description: First Lexington date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

to.description: Last Lexington date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

free.description: true for events whose listing says admission is free.

area.description: A part of Lexington, as on aroundlex.com/near: downtown, distillery-district, northside, east-end, university, chevy-chase, hamburg, south-lexington, west-lexington, north-lexington. downtown includes Rupp Arena, Central Bank Center and the Lexington Opera House.

kids.description: true for events Around Lex tags as good with kids.

limit.description: How many events to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

when.description: today; tonight, from 4 pm (or now, if later) to 3 am Lexington time (with no query words left to match, dates that start in it by start time, then those already under way, then dates that post no start time; a query's matches keep their ranking); or this-weekend, the Friday to Sunday get_weekend covers. Instead of from and to.

town.description: A town, as Around Lex's places name it (case, punctuation and "KY" do not matter): Lexington, Berea, Carlisle, Danville, Frankfort, Georgetown, Harrodsburg, Lawrenceburg, Louisville, Midway, Millersburg, Mt. Sterling, Nicholasville, Paris, Perryville, Richmond, Stamping Ground, Versailles, Wilmore, Winchester.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Use after search_events, or with an aroundlex.com/events/ address, for one event's upcoming dates (up to 12; moreDates counts the rest, and an event with none left shows its last date) with status (scheduled, rescheduled, cancelled or postponed), address, price line and official source. Pass from/to to check a specific date: the answer then lists the event's upcoming dates in that range (up to 60), and moreDates counts its other upcoming dates, outside the range or past those 60. statusNote is the listing's own note on its schedule, such as a time not yet set, when it has one. A slug no event has gets an error that names up to 3 close slugs of coming events. Do not use to find events by topic or date: search_events does that.

slug.description: The last part of an aroundlex.com/events/ address, with or without a year, or a slug from a search result.

from.description: First Lexington date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. With from or to, the answer lists the event's dates in that range.

to.description: Last Lexington date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Give the same date as from to check one day.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Use for a kind of place or a named place in and around Lexington, KY (parks, venues, museums, libraries, restaurants, bars and shops). Returns 10 places by default (limit, up to 20) with names, addresses, official websites and check dates, best match first, plus how many matched in all; no hours or reviews. The query may be in plain words: filler words are dropped and a town's name after in, near, around, at or from, or before KY, sets town (Richmond Road stays a road, and a town's name on its own stays a word; when nothing in that town matches, a place whose name holds the town's and that holds every other word is the answer, with namedFor set to the town: it may be elsewhere, as its address says; droppedWords lists the words left out), and town keeps one town's places. When no place holds every word of three or more, the answer lists the places that hold at least two and at least half of them, most first, and says matched=loose. No hours: for holiday hours or what's open on a date, use get_guide. Do not use for events: search_events has them.

query.description: Words to look for, like "distillery", "playground", "coffee", a place name or a question in plain words ("brunch places in Georgetown").

limit.description: How many places to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

town.description: A town, as Around Lex's places name it (case, punctuation and "KY" do not matter): Lexington, Berea, Carlisle, Danville, Frankfort, Georgetown, Harrodsburg, Lawrenceburg, Louisville, Midway, Millersburg, Mt. Sterling, Nicholasville, Paris, Perryville, Richmond, Stamping Ground, Versailles, Wilmore, Winchester.

tools.name: get_weekend
tools.description: Use for 'this weekend in Lexington': the coming Friday to Sunday, up to 5 Around Lex picks from aroundlex.com/this-weekend (fewer when the weekend has fewer checked events) and the weekend's checked events by date, picks included, 20 by default (limit), each with its date, time, venue, price line, official source and check date. When a pick on aroundlex.com/this-weekend is not listed here, picksOmitted counts it and picksOmittedReason says why. Do not use for one day or tonight: search_events takes when=today or when=tonight.

limit.description: How many of the weekend's dates to list after the picks, 1 to 20. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Use when someone asks what is open or closed on a holiday, holiday hours, trash and recycling schedule changes, church service times, parking and bag rules for UK games, ice skating, date night, rainy-day or snow-day plans, Christmas lights, parades, Thanksgiving or New Year's Eve in Lexington, KY. Returns the best current guide and up to 2 alternatives for a query (or none, with the guides page), or one guide by slug (a slug no guide has gets an error that names up to 3 close guide slugs), with up to 10 of its section titles and of the official pages it cites, with its dated answer and up to 10 of its sections as question and answer (each answer up to 300 characters); link its page for the rest. A past edition or a guide due for a fresh check, opened by slug, gives its titles and state only. Do not use for events on a date: search_events has them.

slug.description: The last part of an aroundlex.com/guides/ address, with or without a year, or a slug from a search result.

query.description: Words to find the best matching current guide, like "christmas lights" or "rainy day".
